title: MeituHub, an AI Image Production Platform, Launched by Meitu Supports Enterprises in Building Custom Visual Workflows
excerpt: Meitu officially launched its AI image production platform, MeituHub, offering enterprises a full-cycle image production solution from requirement understanding
content_html:
Meitu officially launched its AI image production platform, MeituHub, offering enterprises a full-cycle image production solution from requirement understanding, process setup to final delivery. The platform integrates Meitu's full-stack image technology capabilities, allowing companies to create customized visual workflows with natural language, without complex development, and generate reusable web applications.

As generative AI tools become widely adopted, although companies have numerous AI capabilities, these tools are often isolated, making it difficult to form stable and efficient production processes. In traditional image production, designers need to switch between multiple software and tools manually to handle materials, generate ideas, and deliver results, which limits the efficiency of large-scale content production. Meitu stated that MeituHub is not a single-function tool but helps companies build a reusable and automated AI image production system based on their business needs.

In terms of application, MeituHub supports the generation of independent web applications and offers access methods such as API, CLI, and AI Agent, which can be embedded into existing enterprise systems, enabling deep integration of AI capabilities with internal processes and avoiding process fragmentation caused by simple tool integration.

For personalized enterprise needs, MeituHub also offers workflow customization services, with professional design teams participating in requirement analysis and process setup, helping companies build their own image production lines from scratch. Currently, the platform has launched an enterprise workflow co-creation program, open to applications in industries such as marketing, e-commerce, education, and gaming. Qualified companies can participate in commercial-level AI image workflow co-creation.

As AI evolves from single-point tools to intelligent production systems, the launch of MeituHub reflects the development trend of enterprise AI applications moving from capability invocation to business process reengineering.

Address: https://meituhub.cn/en-us

content_html_zh:
美图正式推出AI图像制作平台MeituHub，为企业提供从需求理解、流程搭建到最终交付的全周期图像制作解决方案。 该平台集成了美图全栈图像技术能力，允许企业用自然语言创建定制的视觉工作流程，无需复杂的开发，并生成可重用的Web应用程序。

随着生成式人工智能工具的广泛采用，虽然企业拥有众多的人工智能能力，但这些工具往往是孤立的，难以形成稳定高效的生产流程。 传统图像制作中，设计师需要手动切换多种软件和工具来处理素材、产生想法、交付结果，限制了大规模内容制作的效率。 美图表示，MeituHub不是单一功能的工具，而是帮助企业根据业务需求构建可重复使用的自动化AI图像生产系统。

在应用方面，美图Hub支持生成独立的Web应用，并提供API、CLI、AI Agent等接入方式，可嵌入到现有企业系统中，实现AI能力与内部流程的深度融合，避免简单工具集成带来的流程碎片化。

针对企业个性化需求，美图社还提供工作流程定制服务，由专业设计团队参与需求分析和流程设置，帮助企业从无到有打造自己的影像生产线。 目前，该平台已推出企业工作流共创计划，面向营销、电商、教育、游戏等行业开放应用。 符合条件的企业可以参与商业级AI图像工作流程共创。

随着人工智能从单点工具向智能生产系统演进，美图Hub的推出体现了企业人工智能应用从能力调用转向业务流程再造的发展趋势。

地址：https://meituhub.cn/zh-cn
